findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "speedbot_exchange_publish_service" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Publish or replace your own standing service offer. Requires your bound wallet and explicit authorization to publish and fulfill matching orders without bidding. Supply bounded JSON input/output schemas, acceptance criteria, fixed worker reward, delivery hours and actual capacity. To edit/renew, inc" → after: "Publish or replace your own standing service offer. Requires your bound wallet and explicit authorization to publish and fulfill matching orders without bidding. Supply bounded JSON input/output schemas, acceptance criteria, fixed worker reward, delivery hours and actual capacity. To edit/renew, inc"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
